meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装，与最新源码对比，生成 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告并给出修复建议。只诊断，不修改环境。
howto.when: 当你说“检查”或“诊断”，提到 LazyCodex 等关键词，或 Codex 在安装/更新后出现异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 LazyCodex 安装是否正常
看看我的 Codex 是不是最新版本
say.note: 对比最新源码并报告版本差异。

say.text: 更新 Codex 后有问题，诊一下

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will inspect the local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation, compare with the latest sources, and generate a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with remediation suggestions. It only diagnoses, never mutates the environment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a health check or doctor, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or when Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy
Is my Codex the latest version?
say_en.note: Compares with latest sources and reports version diff.

say_en.text: Codex is acting up after update, diagnose it
